_comment: Maps internal attribution field names to the GHL custom field 'fieldKey' holding each value on a 3 Percent East Coast Contact. Created by provisionAttributionFields against this location, so these keys are verified to match what GHL actually generated. Attribution also requires the landing page to capture fbclid/utm_* into these fields, and each Meta ad set's URL parameters to stamp Meta's dynamic IDs: utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign={{campaign.id}}&utm_content={{ad.id}}&utm_term={{adset.id}}
